title: Tunnel-Drum Brute
text: Tunnel-Drum Brute hammers its plated chest until the ground answers with a hunting tremor. On loss, suffer 1 Wound.
flavor: The second beat always comes from below.

defeatReward.text: Tunnel-Drum Brute is defeated and its identifying marks are entered into your Trophy Pile.
